results.test: HPOS is the authoritative order store
Migration is idempotent and preserves campaign rows
Simple selection has immutable original snapshot and seven-day schedule
Server rejects invalid floors and grouped products
Existing and scheduled sales are rejected without mutation
Known dynamic pricing conflicts are rejected
Variation is enrolled independently; variable parent is rejected
Delayed job applies current day directly to simple and variation
Duplicate job preserves price, stock and snapshot
Pause blocks stale jobs without restoring; resume invalidates old jobs
Restore is repeatable and restores only owned price
Manual price change causes conflict and restore preserves it
Crash after Woo save recovers durable intent without duplicate price reduction
Audit database failure retains durable intent and safe restoration recovers
Atomic lock excludes independent database connection and releases
Lost connection-scoped lock fails closed on reentrant acquire
Corrupted stored schedule cannot apply below floor or above base
Deleted product produces a recorded conflict
Out-of-stock and backorders follow Woo stock settings without mutation
Shipping excludes ordinary cart and mixed-cart ordinary totals
Shipping at threshold affects only allowed flat-rate instance and tax
Shipping uses post-coupon total, quantity/removal, and package-local threshold
Anonymous, invalid nonce and insufficient capability cannot read admin data
Admin nonce grants access and rejects malicious financial payload
Restore requires strict explicit confirmation and item requests reject IDOR/types
Shortcodes render only selected current products without confidential fields
Shortcode pagination uses request page and renders each selected product context
Public countdown endpoint exposes server time and only presentation fields
Classic checkout persists immutable campaign attribution on mixed multitem order
HPOS report counts multitem order once and separates campaign item revenue
Failed/cancelled orders excluded, repeated payment callback does not duplicate reports
Partial line refund reduces campaign revenue and units through real Woo refund CRUD
Blocks checkout lifecycle attributes real draft order and remains immutable
Later campaign price job never changes already saved order totals
Real Action Scheduler worker reaches final-day floor and natural end restores
Failed job schedules bounded retry and real retry worker recovers intent
REST returns sanitized error when operation and diagnostic audit writes both fail
Concurrent daily price change preserves attribution of an already calculated classic cart
